title: Purchase Order Template
description: Free GST purchase order format for India with PO number, vendor and ship-to details, HSN codes, CGST/SGST, delivery date and terms. Use it in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Itemised table with HSN, rate and CGST/SGST split
Vendor, bill-to and ship-to blocks with GSTIN
Delivery, payment and invoicing terms with authorised signatory
research: All references show a unique PO number and date, buyer and vendor details with GSTIN, ship-to address, itemised lines with HSN, quantity, rate and GST, a delivery date, payment terms and an authorised signature; once the vendor accepts it the PO binds both sides.

blocks.heading: Terms and conditions
text: 1. **Delivery:** deliver all items to the ship-to address by the date above, between 10:00 and 17:00 on working days.
2. **Quality:** goods must match the quotation and specifications; damaged or wrong items will be returned at your cost.
3. **Invoice:** raise a GST tax invoice quoting this PO number, our GSTIN and HSN codes; send it with the delivery challan.
4. **Payment:** by bank transfer within [30 days] of receiving goods and a correct invoice.
5. Please confirm acceptance of this order within [2 working days]. Changes are valid only in writing.
